info.background_text:
Overly quiet sniper.
Utilizes the advantage of being inconspicuous to excel in her role. Selena is so skilled that sometimes everyone forgets about her presence as a sniper. When forgotten, she may seem a bit crestfallen, but she remains more dedicated to White Altair than anyone else.
